category_title: Preschoolers with Autism and communication delays who exhibit physical aggression during activity transitions
minimal_context: Chris is playing with toys in the pre-kindergarten classroom and is instructed to clean up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Chris, playtime is over. It is time to put the toys away and stop playing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Drops to the floor and speaks with poor articulation) N-no!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to get up off the floor and clean up.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Elopes from the activity area, running away from the toys) No!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Chris, come back here right now and listen to me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs an item from a nearby table, throws it across the classroom, and starts kicking) No!
